env.name: ${REDIS_LEASE_URL_NAME}
env.description: Redis connection string for lease coordinator.

in_memory.label: In-memory (single process only)
in_memory.config_snippet:
# WARNING [USER]: InMemoryLease is single-process only.
    #   Multiple workers will not coordinate. Use RedisLease for production.
    lease = oak_session.InMemoryLease()

none.label: None (no coordination)
none.config_snippet:
# WARNING [USER]: No lease configured.
    #   Concurrent attach() calls across processes can race on the same
    #   session_id. Acceptable only for single-worker deployments.
    lease = None

custom.label: Custom (stub)
custom.config_snippet:
# TODO [USER]: implement your own LeaseManager.
    #   Must satisfy oak_session.LeaseManager Protocol
    #   (async acquire / renew / release).
    lease = MyCustomLease()

none.label: None (console only)
none.config_snippet: trace = None  # no remote trace source; rehydration starts empty
